Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

Can you confirm me that effects like "Superior Psyche! nullify after combat ends effects like Superior Pass Through Shadow ?
(Reference: Thread of this forum: www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/82059-pass-through-shadow-form-of-mist-and-psyche#113602)

I am asking mainly about: Akram, Pocket of Time and Jalal Sayad.

Extended question, if more cards effects would begin a new combat, would it be automatic to understand that those other cards effects would nullify any "after combat ends effects" ?

Card texts:
Psyche! (Superior Celerity)
Only usable at the end of a round when both combatants are still ready and combat is about to end. After this round, begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Pass Through Shadow (Superior)
Strike: combat ends. After combat ends, put this card on this vampire. This vampire can burn this card to get +1 stealth.

Akram
Once each turn after completing combat, if Akram and the opposing minion are still ready, Akram may burn 1 blood to begin another combat with the opposing minion.

Pocket out of Time (Superior Temporis)
Usable after combat. After any combat this action, this vampire can burn 1 blood to start a new combat with the opposing minion (if both combatants are still ready).

Jalal Sayad
Once each turn after combat ends, Jalal can burn 1 blood to start a new combat with the opposing minion. Blood cursed.

Thanks in advance,
Rémi.
